data.gender_notes: Hardik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'hardas' which means 'strong' or 'powerful'. The name Hardik is also considered to be an abbreviated form of the name Haridhara, which is a combination of 'hari' (God Vishnu) and 'dhara' (supporter or sustainer). In Hindu mythology, Hardik is believed to represent strength, power, and intelligence.
